caption:
More rules on a certificate doesn't always mean more lab tests.
Under 16 CFR 1110.11(d), the certificate still lists each applicable rule separately. But certifiers aren't required to run the same third party test on a sample more than once when one rule references or fully incorporates another with the same requirement.
If a lab quote repeats the same test for overlapping rules, it's fair to ask why.
Ask before you pay twice.

sources.claim: Same third party test not required twice when one rule fully incorporates another
sources.quote: (d) Duplicative testing not required. Although finished product certificates must list each applicable rule, ban, standard, or regulation separately, finished product certifiers are not required to conduct the same third party test on each sample more than once when a rule references, or incorporates fully, another applicable consumer product safety rule or similar rule, ban, standard, or regulation under any other law enforced by the Commission with the same requirement.
